source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: Interim results of a phase 2 trial of selumetinib (NCT02407405) in adults with symptomatic inoperable NF1 plexiform neurofibromas show a 69% response rate, with a median time to response of 11 months.
notes: Full text (PMC9629420, HTML). Statement made by the de Blank 2022 review citing Coyne 2020 (ref 39; J Clin Oncol abstract, no PMID). Secondary citation: the claim is not independent of the cited primary study; read the primary paper for strength grading. Interim conference abstract.
